description: This file defines the Express router for admin-related routes in a backend application, including login, doctor management, appointments, and dashboard endpoints.

methods.name: adminRouter.post("/add-doctor")
methods.description: Handles adding a new doctor, with image upload and admin authentication.

methods.name: adminRouter.get("/appointments")
methods.description: Retrieves appointments for admin view, with admin authentication.

methods.name: adminRouter.post("/cancel-appointment")
methods.description: Cancels an appointment, with admin authentication.

methods.name: adminRouter.get("/all-doctors")
methods.description: Retrieves list of all doctors, with admin authentication.

methods.name: adminRouter.post("/change-availability")
methods.description: Changes doctor availability, with admin authentication.

methods.name: adminRouter.get("/dashboard")
methods.description: Provides admin dashboard data, with admin authentication.
